The FloPlast push-fit 92.5° double socket bend is a robust 110mm drainage component designed for efficient soil and vent systems. Manufactured from lightweight uPVC, it offers strength and durability, making it suitable for various drainage installations where reliable pipework is essential. The bend is easy to work with and accommodates high-temperature waste discharges effectively. Using silicone lubricant on all ring seal joints facilitates a smooth and secure connection during installation, ensuring a dependable drainage solution.
